The company

Three engineering disciplines, one plan

AA Energy Consultans IKE is a consulting engineering company based in Pylaia, Thessaloniki. It brings together surveying, environmental engineering and civil engineering to support municipalities, public bodies and businesses in energy, environmental and education projects.

We have worked on the implementation and completion of energy upgrades of municipal street lighting, on field studies such as mapping water-meter locations, and on information campaigns and workshops about the circular economy.

Each project is followed by the engineer whose discipline it needs — and the team works on it together from the first meeting to the final deliverable.

Services

What we take on for municipalities, public bodies and businesses

01

Energy upgrades of street lighting

Support for municipalities and public bodies through the implementation and completion of energy upgrades of municipal street lighting.

02

Engineering studies & technical advice

Technical advice, studies and field surveys — such as the study and mapping of water-meter locations for a municipality.

03

Environmental consulting

Scientific and technical advice on environmental matters, with a focus on the circular economy and proper waste management.

04

Project management & business consulting

Advice on organising, monitoring and completing projects, as well as management consulting for businesses.

05

Hands-on workshops & education

Programmes of hands-on workshops and facilitation for pupils and adults, as support services for education.

06

Information & digital material

Design of information and educational material, printed and digital, for awareness and communication campaigns.

Questions

Frequently asked

What does AA Energy Consultans do?

We are a consulting engineering company in Thessaloniki. We support municipalities, public bodies and businesses in energy projects — such as upgrading street lighting — in environmental matters, in project management and in hands-on education programmes.

Where is your office?

At 52 Dimitriou Tsiapanou St., 543 52 Pylaia, in eastern Thessaloniki. Please call before you come so we can arrange a meeting.

Do you take on projects outside Thessaloniki?

Yes. We have worked for the Municipality of Larissa in Thessaly, the Municipality of Aristotelis in Chalkidiki and the Municipality of Lagadas.

Who are the company’s engineers?

The partners are Apostolos Antonoudis, surveying engineer, Sotirios Efstathios Antonoudis, environmental engineer, and Ioannis Keramidas, civil engineering technologist.

What do the hands-on workshops include?

Facilitated activities for groups of pupils and adults on the circular economy, re-use and proper waste management — together with the information material that goes with them.

How can I contact you?

Call +30 2310 936 313 or the mobile +30 697 611 1440 (Apostolos Antonoudis), or e-mail aaenergy61@gmail.com.
